title: Cascade Robotics Standup - Firmware Bug Triage

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Morning. Gustavo, what's the latest on the motor controller firmware bug?

transcript.speaker: Gustavo Ferreira
transcript.text: Found it - it's a race condition in the PID loop when the encoder interrupt fires during a parameter update. Under load, the motor occasionally jerks for a fraction of a second.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: That matches what we saw on unit 14 yesterday. Can you get a fix in today?

transcript.speaker: Gustavo Ferreira
transcript.text: Yes, I'll add a lock around the parameter update and push a patch build by end of day.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
transcript.text: Once you push it, I'll flash it to the three test units on the bench and run the stress rig overnight.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Good. Hannah, any update on the battery supplier?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
transcript.text: They confirmed the new cell shipment is delayed two weeks - customs hold. I'll email procurement today to see if we can expedite or find a backup supplier.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Two weeks pushes our demo unit assembly close to the deadline. Let's decide today, not later this week, whether we swap to the backup supplier if procurement can't expedite by Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Gustavo Ferreira
transcript.text: Agreed, we can't afford to wait on that.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: One open question - do we need to requalify the whole battery pack if we switch suppliers, or just the cells?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
transcript.text: Good question, I don't know off the top of my head - I'll ask the certification team.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Thanks both, that's it for today.

summary_key_points: Found and will fix a race condition in the motor controller firmware
Overnight stress testing planned on three units once the patch lands
The new battery cell shipment is delayed two weeks by customs
The team will decide by Wednesday whether to switch battery suppliers

action_items.task: Fix the PID loop race condition and push a patch build by end of day
Flash the patch to the three test units and run an overnight stress test
Email procurement about expediting the battery cell shipment or finding a backup supplier

decisions: Decide by Wednesday whether to switch to the backup battery supplier if procurement can't expedite
